desc:
Ride, explore, and build your dream stable in a vibrant world of horses! 🐴 Tame wild horses, discover rare species, and breed them to create your perfect companion. Will you build the ultimate stable?

🆕 New: 
🎃 The Halloween event continues! New Anticorn and Caniquine Halloween subspecies!
🧡 CALAVERITA is a new event horse!
🌳 Main realm spawn revamp! We're going to continue working on the map!

🏠 Home System — build and decorate your own space!
🐎 Breed horses together and discover their unique traits and personalities!
🗺️ Explore 3 maps — Main World, Market World and the Competitor Hub!
🌟 Meet NPCs with quests and stores!
⚡ Discover rare Horse mutations including the Astral!
🏆 Compete in races and activities!
🌿 Seasonal events and deep customization options.

Tags: Horse, Unicorn, Pegasus, Pony, Fantasy, Racing, Breeding, Taming, Roleplay, RPG, Pets
